saw_lines: Sleepwear is bought by fit and feel, so buyers try one piece, then return for the same cut in more colors.
So the sale is won or lost in line one, where a buyer decides if the fit is worth a click.
Your 11 of 28 copy ads repeat one exact copy, so keep it as the base and change the opening line and creative in each, starting with three new photos.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 3 Nov 2026
points: One exact copy runs in 11 of 28 ads, so the same message wears out fast. Keep that copy as the base but change the opening line and creative in each. Shoot three new photos of the layering look.
None of your 28 copy ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer has no reason to trust you. Collect one real figure, a review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it.
11 of your 28 copy ads open on the Second Skin line, so one story leads and no other opening gets tested. Test two new angles against it: a cold morning fit and a long evening line, three ads each.
Your site promotes free shipping from 69€, yet 0 of 28 copy ads mention it, so a new buyer sees no reason to act. Open three new ads with free shipping from 69€ aimed at first orders.

ads_1: Second Skin layering looks with new openers for cold mornings and long evenings
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, TikTok, YouTube
